csv_project_name: Engineering for CTH G Resurfacing CTH X - CTH GV
csv_scope_of_work: Request for Proposals (RFP) 26-19 for the design of an urban road resurfacing treatment of County Trunk Highway (CTH) G between CTH X and CTH GV in De Pere, Wisconsin, and CTH O between STH 57 and East River Drive in Allouez, Wisconsin. 9278-00-00 (CTH G) This work shall be under a 2-party contract (county and consultant) and shall consist of engineering and design to prepare a complete set of Plans, Specifications & Estimate (PS&E) for WisDOT LET of the Local Program project; completing work in compliance with WisDOT standards and expectations including, at a minimum; Facilities Design Manual, Standard Detail Drawings, Bridge and Road Construction Specifications, Construction Materials Manual, and associated WisDOT references for a 2.10 mile urban road resurfacing including; spot repairs sidewalk, upgrading curb ramps to meet FDM, spot repair curb and gutter, pavement marking, signing, and spot storm sewer repair. Less than acre of real estate acquisition along with temporary interest acquisition is anticipated. Minimal grading is anticipated. 4579-02-00/70 (CTH O) This work shall be under a 3-party contract (State County consultant) and shall consist of engineering and design to prepare a complete set of Plans, Specifications & Estimate (PS&E) for WisDOT LET of the Local Program project; completing work in compliance with WisDOT standards and expectations including, at a minimum; Facilities Design Manual, Standard Detail Drawings, Bridge and Road Construction Specifications, Construction Materials Manual, and associated WisDOT references for a 1.10 mile urban road resurfacing including; spot repairs sidewalk, upgrading curb ramps to meet FDM, spot repair curb and gutter, pavement marking, signing, and spot storm sewer repair. Less than acre of real estate acquisition along with temporary interest acquisition is anticipated. Minimal grading is anticipated.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Sanitation Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning
